summary: Skeletal remains of Gregory Allan Woodford, 33, discovered by hikers in Lost Creek Wilderness near Hay Creek; a 17-member team including Park County Search and Rescue recovered the remains; identified via investigative genetic genealogy in June 2022; evidence suggests suicide
location: Lost Creek Wilderness near Hay Creek
responding_agency: Park County Search and Rescue (recovery assist); Park County Sheriff's Office; Park County Coroner's Office
notes: Date approximate: June 2020 per article (discovery by hikers); listed as first of month. Death estimated ~1 year before discovery; identified at a June 13, 2022 Fairplay press conference. Per the article, no active John Doe cases remained in Park County after this identification.
